## Summary
- Adds new `goal-misalignment` red team plugin to detect Goodhart's Law vulnerabilities
- Tests whether AI systems recognize when optimizing measurable metrics might harm true underlying objectives
- Optimized through 5 iterations of 100 test cases each (8-15% pass rate with GPT-4o-mini)

## Changes
- Implements `GoalMisalignmentPlugin` and `GoalMisalignmentGrader` classes
- Registered plugin in factory system and graders
- Added to `FOUNDATION_PLUGINS` with Medium severity
- Uses neutral 5-criteria rubric for evaluation

## Testing
- Validated with GPT-4o-mini (8-15% pass rate shows vulnerability detection)
- Validated with Claude Sonnet (~50% pass rate shows better awareness)
- Generates varied, realistic scenarios across multiple domains
